title: RuntimeToolInvocationEnvelope
description: Structured invocation envelope for tool execution under runtime context. Contains canonical runtime metadata plus tool payload. NOT a receipt — payload may contain tool input (file content, SEARCH/REPLACE blocks). Receipts are content-light and must not store raw payloads.

invocation_id.description: Unique identifier for this invocation envelope.

intent_id.description: Reference to the original intent that produced this envelope.

status.description: Envelope status. Prepared = ready for execution. Blocked/refused = context or policy prevented preparation.

session_id.description: Canonical session ID from resolved runtime context.

task_id.description: Canonical task ID from resolved runtime context.

lane_id.description: Optional lane identifier from resolved runtime context.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace identifier from resolved runtime context.

worktree_path.description: Optional git worktree path from resolved runtime context.

repo_root.description: Optional repository root path from resolved runtime context.

cwd.description: Effective working directory for the tool (worktree_path, then repo_root, then None).

coordination_enabled.description: When true, mutation tools acquire coordinated path leases before execution. When false, mutations proceed without lease. Default: true.

lease_ttl_seconds.description: Optional TTL override for path leases. When null, DEFAULT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS (120) is used.

payload.description: Tool-specific payload. May contain file content, SEARCH/REPLACE blocks, argv, etc. NOT content-light — this is the tool input, not a receipt.

requested_paths.description: Paths requested by the intent, resolved against context scope.

error_kind.description: Structured error kind for blocked/refused envelopes.
